title: רב שמואל בר אחיתאי

paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Ahitai said in Rav Hamnuna the Elder's name, who said in R' Yitzhak bar Ashyan's name, who said in Rav Huna's name, who said in Rav's name: Sukkah 42a. In Gittin 39, end of side b: R' Shmuel bar Ahotai said in Rav Hamnuna the Elder's name, who said in R' Yitzhak bar Ashyan's name, who said in Rav Huna's name, who said in Rav Hamnuna's name. The word Hamnuna is a scribal error.
